title: Swarovski Kristallwelten Wattens
highlights: Ikonischer wassergespeiter Riese als Portal zu 18 unterirdischen Wunderkammern
Kunstinstallationen internationaler Starkünstler wie Yayoi Kusama und Brian Eno
Weitläufiger Garten mit funkelnder Kristallwolke über dem glitzernden Spiegelwasser
Vierstöckiger Spielturm und innovativer Spielplatz für Kinder und Familien
kurzbeschreibung: The Swarovski Kristallwelten in Wattens enchant visitors with 18 subterranean Chambers of Wonder, the water-spouting Giant, and the Crystal Cloud.
beschreibung:
Sparkling Wonderland of the Giant

The Swarovski Kristallwelten in Wattens were conceived by multimedia artist André Heller on the occasion of the company's centenary. Behind the iconic, grass-covered head of the Giant lies an underground labyrinth full of sparkling magic and contemporary art.

Fascinating Chambers of Art and Gardens

In 18 individually designed Chambers of Wonder, renowned designers and artists interpret crystal in astonishing dimensions. In the spacious garden area, the floating Crystal Cloud, made of more than 800,000 hand-set crystals, captivates every visitor.
